Taking Bookings For Christmas Parties 020 7286 7896 TSIAKKOSCHARCOAL@GMAIL.COM 5a Maryland Road, London, W9 2DU TUE TO SAT 6PM - 11PM book a table 5a MarylandS Road, London, W9 2DU TSIAKKOSCHARCOAL@GMAIL.COM 020 7286 7896 tuesday to Friday 6pm - 11pm SATURDAY 1PM - 11PM "It's just so damn lovely" Jay Rayner Welcome Come and sample our traditional authentic Greek Cypriot food and celebrate the joy of eating dishes that have been passed down through generations. All our food is homemade and cooked in the open kitchen at the front of the restaurant as you walk in. The chargrilled dishes are cooked on live charcoals which is a rare find nowadays. BOOK A TABLE MENUS DELIVEROO CELEBRATE WITH US! We are very happy to accommodate your special occasions and celebrations. Our garden room can be booked for functions for up to fifty people. For groups of 8 or more, we only offer our house speciality Meze for £40 per person. We can also cater for external parties.
